description: Resource deployment manifest for ThoughtMachine — documents every file that bootstrap.py deploys from resources/ to the user's ~/.thoughtmachine/ directory.

files.description: Agent configuration overlay (diff from factory defaults — merged with resources/default_config.json at load time)
System prompt for the engineer/architect agent role

notes: Global knowledge base (resources/global_kb/*.md → ~/.thoughtmachine/knowledge/system/) is handled separately by agent/knowledge/global_kb.py::ensure_global_kb()
User subdirectory structure (~/.thoughtmachine/sessions/, state/, knowledge/) is created by bootstrap.py::ensure_user_defaults()
This manifest is the single source of truth for resource deployment. The RESOURCE_MAP dict in bootstrap.py is derived from this file.
